WITH traffic_source_revenue AS (
  SELECT trafficSource.source as source,
         SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as total_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_2017*`
  WHERE totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY trafficSource.source
),
top_source AS (
  SELECT source
  FROM traffic_source_revenue
  ORDER BY total_rev DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
         SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_rev
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_2017*`
  WHERE trafficSource.source = (SELECT source FROM top_source)
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT source FROM top_source) as traffic_source,
  ROUND((MAX(monthly_rev) - MIN(monthly_rev)) / 1000000, 2) as diff_in_millions
FROM monthly_revenue

SELECT 
  t.trafficSource.source as traffic_source,
  t.date as sale_date,
  SUM(p.productRevenue) as product_revenue
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_20170101` as t,
UNNEST(t.hits) as h,
UNNEST(h.product) as p
WHERE t.trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY traffic_source, sale_date

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_transaction AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.deviceCategory,
    device.isMobile,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC, visitNumber ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL 
    AND totals.transactions > 0
)
SELECT ft.fullVisitorId AS visitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_transaction ft ON fv.fullVisitorId = ft.fullVisitorId AND ft.rn = 1
WHERE ft.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
  AND ft.date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY visitorId

SELECT nppes_provider_state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM (
  SELECT nppes_provider_state, drug_name, SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claims,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nppes_provider_state ORDER BY SUM(total_claim_count) DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  WHERE nppes_provider_state NOT IN ('ZZ', 'XX', 'AE', 'MP', 'AP', 'AA')
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY nppes_provider_state

WITH wa_stations AS (
  SELECT usaf, wban, name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
  WHERE state = 'WA'
),
rainy_2023 AS (
  SELECT stn, wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023`
  WHERE year = '2023'
    AND prcp > 0
    AND prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY stn, wban
),
rainy_2022 AS (
  SELECT stn, wban, COUNT(*) AS rainy_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE year = '2022'
    AND prcp > 0
    AND prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY stn, wban
)
SELECT 
  ws.name AS station_name,
  ws.usaf,
  ws.wban,
  r23.rainy_days AS rainy_days_2023,
  r22.rainy_days AS rainy_days_2022
FROM wa_stations ws
JOIN rainy_2023 r23 ON ws.usaf = r23.stn AND ws.wban = r23.wban
JOIN rainy_2022 r22 ON ws.usaf = r22.stn AND ws.wban = r22.wban
WHERE r23.rainy_days > 150
  AND r23.rainy_days < r22.rainy_days
ORDER BY r23.rainy_days DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH weather AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    value / 10.0 as precipitation_mm,
    CASE WHEN value / 10.0 > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025'
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND date BETWEEN DATE '2016-01-01' AND DATE '2016-12-31'
    AND mflag IS NULL
    AND qflag IS NULL
),
trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE starttime >= '2016-01-01' AND starttime < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
)
SELECT 
  w.weather_condition,
  ROUND(AVG(t.daily_trips), 2) as avg_daily_trips
FROM weather w
JOIN trips t ON w.date = t.trip_date
GROUP BY w.weather_condition
ORDER BY w.weather_condition

-- For now, I'll keep them as separate stations since they have different IDs in the trip data.

SELECT 
  station_name,
  group_rides,
  total_end_trips,
  ROUND(proportion, 10) as proportion
FROM (
  WITH same_station_trips AS (
    SELECT 
      start_station_id as station_id,
      UNIX_SECONDS(starttime) / 120 as two_min_bucket
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
  ),
  window_counts AS (
    SELECT 
      station_id,
      two_min_bucket,
      COUNT(*) as trip_count
    FROM same_station_trips
    GROUP BY station_id, two_min_bucket
  ),
  group_windows AS (
    SELECT 
      station_id,
      two_min_bucket,
      trip_count
    FROM window_counts
    WHERE trip_count > 1
  ),
  group_rides_per_station AS (
    SELECT 
      station_id,
      SUM(trip_count) as group_rides
    FROM group_windows
    GROUP BY station_id
  ),
  total_end_trips AS (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id,
      COUNT(*) as total_end_trips
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    GROUP BY end_station_id
  ),
  station_names AS (
    SELECT 
      end_station_id,
      end_station_name,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY end_station_id ORDER BY end_station_name) as rn
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT end_station_id, end_station_name FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`)
  ),
  combined AS (
    SELECT 
      t.end_station_id,
      sn.end_station_name as station_name,
      COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0) as group_rides,
      t.total_end_trips,
      SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(g.group_rides, 0), t.total_end_trips) as proportion
    FROM total_end_trips t
    LEFT JOIN group_rides_per_station g ON t.end_station_id = g.station_id
    LEFT JOIN station_names sn ON t.end_station_id = sn.end_station_id AND sn.rn = 1
    WHERE t.total_end_trips > 0
  )
  SELECT 
    station_name,
    group_rides,
    total_end_trips,
    ROUND(proportion, 10) as proportion
  FROM combined
  ORDER BY proportion DESC
  LIMIT 10
)

WITH top20_bike_routes AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_name, 
    end_station_name, 
    ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count,
    AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
  GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
  ORDER BY trip_count DESC
  LIMIT 20
),
taxi_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
    ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lon,
    ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
    ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lon,
    AVG(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND)) as avg_taxi_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
  WHERE pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) > 0
    AND trip_distance > 0
  GROUP BY ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3), ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3), ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3)
)
SELECT 
  b.start_station_name,
  b.end_station_name,
  b.avg_bike_duration
FROM top20_bike_routes b
JOIN taxi_avg t 
  ON b.start_lat = t.start_lat 
  AND b.start_lon = t.start_lon
  AND b.end_lat = t.end_lat
  AND b.end_lon = t.end_lon
WHERE b.avg_bike_duration < t.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY b.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH filtered_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_location_id,
    t.passenger_count,
    t.trip_distance,
    t.tip_amount,
    t.tolls_amount,
    t.mta_tax,
    t.fare_amount,
    t.total_amount,
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.dropoff_datetime,
    tz.borough AS pickup_borough
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
    ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP('2016-01-01 00:00:00')
    AND t.pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP('2016-01-08 00:00:00')
    AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
    AND t.passenger_count > 0
    AND t.trip_distance >= 0
    AND t.tip_amount >= 0
    AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
    AND t.mta_tax >= 0
    AND t.fare_amount >= 0
    AND t.total_amount >= 0
)
SELECT 
  pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 OR total_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 OR total_amount = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 AS no_tip_percentage
FROM filtered_trips
GROUP BY pickup_borough
ORDER BY pickup_borough

WITH total_stations AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_id) AS total_stations
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations`
  GROUP BY borough_name
),
eligible_stations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    s.borough_name,
    s.station_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` e
    ON s.station_name = e.station_name
  WHERE e.entry = TRUE AND e.ada_compliant = TRUE
),
eligible_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    borough_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT station_name) AS eligible_stations
  FROM eligible_stations
  GROUP BY borough_name
)
SELECT 
  t.borough_name,
  t.total_stations,
  COALESCE(e.eligible_stations, 0) AS eligible_stations,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(e.eligible_stations, 0), t.total_stations) * 100 AS percentage
FROM total_stations t
LEFT JOIN eligible_counts e ON t.borough_name = e.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    trip_id,
    duration_sec,
    start_date,
    CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) as year_month,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) ORDER BY start_date ASC, trip_id ASC) as rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) ORDER BY start_date DESC, trip_id DESC) as rn_last
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
),
first_trips AS (
  SELECT year_month, duration_sec as first_duration
  FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1
),
last_trips AS (
  SELECT year_month, duration_sec as last_duration
  FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1
),
minmax AS (
  SELECT 
    CONCAT(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS STRING), LPAD(CAST(EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) AS STRING), 2, '0')) as year_month,
    MIN(duration_sec) as min_duration,
    MAX(duration_sec) as max_duration
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT 
  mm.year_month,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(ft.first_duration, 60) as first_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(lt.last_duration, 60) as last_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(mm.max_duration, 60) as highest_duration_minutes,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(mm.min_duration, 60) as lowest_duration_minutes
FROM minmax mm
JOIN first_trips ft ON mm.year_month = ft.year_month
JOIN last_trips lt ON mm.year_month = lt.year_month
ORDER BY mm.year_month

WITH trips_with_region AS (
  SELECT 
    t.trip_id,
    t.duration_sec,
    t.start_date,
    t.start_station_name,
    t.member_gender,
    r.name AS region_name,
    r.region_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_id ORDER BY t.start_date DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
    ON CAST(t.start_station_id AS STRING) = s.station_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` r
    ON s.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE t.start_date >= '2014-01-01' AND t.start_date < '2018-01-01'
    AND s.region_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  region_name,
  trip_id,
  duration_sec,
  start_date,
  start_station_name,
  member_gender
FROM trips_with_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_name

WITH bike_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_WITHIN(s.station_geom, b.neighborhood_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
crime_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as incident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` i
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_WITHIN(ST_GEOGPOINT(i.longitude, i.latitude), b.neighborhood_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT bc.neighborhood, bc.station_count, cc.incident_count
FROM bike_counts bc
JOIN crime_counts cc ON bc.neighborhood = cc.neighborhood
ORDER BY bc.neighborhood

    win_seed AS seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa

  WHERE season >= 2014
  
  UNION ALL
  
  -- Historical tournament games from 2014 onwards (loss rows)
  SELECT 
    season,
    'loss' AS label,
    lose_seed AS seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    win_seed AS opponent_seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`

  UNION ALL

  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`

combined AS (
  SELECT 
    tg.season,
    tg.label,
    tg.seed,
    tg.school_ncaa,
    tg.opponent_seed,
    tg.opponent_school_ncaa,
    fe.pace_rank,
    fe.poss_40min,

    fe.efficiency_rank,
    fe.pts_100poss,
    fe.efficiency_rating,
    fe_opp.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,

    fe_opp.efficiency_rank AS opp_efficiency_rank,
    fe_opp.pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rating AS opp_efficiency_rating
  FROM tournament_games tg
  LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe 
    ON tg.school_ncaa = fe.team AND tg.season = fe.season
  LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp 
    ON tg.opponent_school_ncaa = fe_opp.team AND tg.season = fe_opp.season
)
SELECT

  opp_poss_40min,

  opp_efficiency_rank,

  opp_efficiency_rating,
  opp_pace_rank - pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  opp_poss_40min - poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  opp_pace_rating - pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  opp_efficiency_rank - efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  opp_pts_100poss - pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  opp_efficiency_rating - efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM combined

SELECT

    q.comment_count AS question_comment_count
FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a 
    ON a.parent_id = q.id 
    AND a.id = q.accepted_answer_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` q_a 
    ON q_a.id = a.owner_user_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users` q_asker 
    ON q_asker.id = q.owner_user_id
WHERE q.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' 
    AND q.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
    AND a.creation_date >= '2016-01-01' 
    AND a.creation_date < '2016-02-01'
    AND q.tags LIKE '%javascript%'
    AND (q.tags LIKE '%xss%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cross-site%' OR q.tags LIKE '%exploit%' OR q.tags LIKE '%cybersecurity%')

WITH user_answers AS (
  SELECT pa.id AS answer_id, pa.parent_id, pq.tags
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` pa
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` pq ON pa.parent_id = pq.id
  WHERE pa.owner_user_id = 1908967
    AND pa.creation_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-06-07')
),
answer_votes AS (
  SELECT 
    ua.answer_id,
    ua.parent_id,
    ua.tags,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvote_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN v.vote_type_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_count
  FROM user_answers ua
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.votes` v ON ua.answer_id = v.post_id
  GROUP BY ua.answer_id, ua.parent_id, ua.tags
),
tag_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    tag,
    SUM(upvote_count * 10 + accepted_count * 15) AS total_score
  FROM answer_votes,
  UNNEST(SPLIT(tags, '|')) AS tag
  WHERE tag != ''
  GROUP BY tag
)
SELECT tag, total_score
FROM tag_scores
ORDER BY total_score DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH alive_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE deceased IS NULL OR deceased.dateTime IS NULL
),
diagnosed_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject.patientId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition`
  WHERE code.text IN ('Diabetes', 'Hypertension')
    AND clinicalStatus = 'active'
    AND verificationStatus = 'confirmed'
),
medication_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    subject.patientId,
    COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.coding[ordinal(1)].code) as distinct_meds
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request`
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.coding[ordinal(1)].code) >= 7
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as patient_count
FROM alive_patients ap
INNER JOIN diagnosed_patients dp ON ap.id = dp.patientId
INNER JOIN medication_counts mc ON ap.id = mc.patientId

WITH matching_clones AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted`
    WHERE (Chr = 'chr13' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 48481890 AND `End` >= 48303751)
       OR (Chr = 'chr17' AND Type = 'Loss' AND Start <= 7687490 AND `End` >= 7668421)
       OR (Chr = 'chr11' AND Type = 'Gain' AND Start <= 108369102 AND `End` >= 108223067)
    GROUP BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Chr) = 3
),
c13_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr13' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 48481890 AND c.`End` >= 48303751
),
c17_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr17' AND c.Type = 'Loss' AND c.Start <= 7687490 AND c.`End` >= 7668421
),
c11_detail AS (
    SELECT mc.RefNo, mc.CaseNo, mc.InvNo, mc.Clone,
           c.ChrOrd, c.Start, c.`End`, c.Type
    FROM matching_clones mc
    JOIN `mitelman-db.prod.CytoConverted` c 
        ON mc.RefNo = c.RefNo AND mc.CaseNo = c.CaseNo AND mc.InvNo = c.InvNo AND mc.Clone = c.Clone
    WHERE c.Chr = 'chr11' AND c.Type = 'Gain' AND c.Start <= 108369102 AND c.`End` >= 108223067
),
kary AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, CloneNo AS Clone, CloneShort
    FROM `mitelman-db.prod.KaryClone`
),
c13_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_13,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_13
    FROM c13_detail
),
c17_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_17,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_17
    FROM c17_detail
),
c11_agg AS (
    SELECT RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone,
           FIRST_VALUE(ChrOrd) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS ChrOrd_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(Start) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Start_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(`End`) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS End_11,
           FIRST_VALUE(Type) OVER (PARTITION BY RefNo, CaseNo, InvNo, Clone ORDER BY Start) AS Type_11
    FROM c11_detail
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    ca.RefNo,
    ca.CaseNo,
    ca.InvNo,
    ca.Clone,
    ca.ChrOrd_13,
    ca.Start_13,
    ca.End_13,
    ca.Type_13,
    cb.ChrOrd_17,
    cb.Start_17,
    cb.End_17,
    cb.Type_17,
    cc.ChrOrd_11,
    cc.Start_11,
    cc.End_11,
    cc.Type_11,
    k.CloneShort
FROM c13_agg ca
JOIN c17_agg cb ON ca.RefNo = cb.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = cb.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = cb.InvNo AND ca.Clone = cb.Clone
JOIN c11_agg cc ON ca.RefNo = cc.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = cc.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = cc.InvNo AND ca.Clone = cc.Clone
LEFT JOIN kary k ON ca.RefNo = k.RefNo AND ca.CaseNo = k.CaseNo AND ca.InvNo = k.InvNo AND ca.Clone = k.Clone
ORDER BY ca.RefNo, ca.CaseNo, ca.InvNo, ca.Clone

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id, 
    a.assay_id, 
    a.doc_id, 
    a.molregno, 
    a.standard_relation, 
    SAFE_CAST(a.standard_value AS FLOAT64) AS standard_value_f,
    a.standard_type, 
    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) AS pchembl_value_f,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) AS heavy_atoms,
    cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE cp.heavy_atoms IS NOT NULL 
    AND SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
    AND a.potential_duplicate = '0'
),
mol_assay_counts AS (
  SELECT molregno, assay_id, standard_type, COUNT(*) AS act_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY molregno, assay_id, standard_type
),
valid AS (
  SELECT b.*
  FROM base b
  JOIN mol_assay_counts mac ON b.molregno = mac.molregno 
    AND b.assay_id = mac.assay_id 
    AND b.standard_type = mac.standard_type
  WHERE mac.act_count < 5
),
molecules_per_group AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molregno, assay_id, standard_type
  FROM valid
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    m1.molregno AS molregno_1,
    m2.molregno AS molregno_2,
    m1.assay_id,
    m1.standard_type
  FROM molecules_per_group m1
  JOIN molecules_per_group m2 
    ON m1.assay_id = m2.assay_id 
    AND m1.standard_type = m2.standard_type
    AND m1.molregno < m2.molregno
),
pair_activities AS (
  SELECT 
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    v1.activity_id AS activity_id_1,
    v1.canonical_smiles AS smiles_1,
    v1.standard_value_f AS std_val_1,
    v1.standard_relation AS rel_1,
    v1.doc_id AS doc_id_1,
    v1.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_1,
    v2.activity_id AS activity_id_2,
    v2.canonical_smiles AS smiles_2,
    v2.standard_value_f AS std_val_2,
    v2.standard_relation AS rel_2,
    v2.doc_id AS doc_id_2,
    v2.heavy_atoms AS heavy_atoms_2
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN valid v1 ON p.molregno_1 = v1.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = v1.assay_id 
    AND p.standard_type = v1.standard_type
  JOIN valid v2 ON p.molregno_2 = v2.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = v2.assay_id 
    AND p.standard_type = v2.standard_type
),
docs_info AS (
  SELECT doc_id, journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) AS year_val, SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64) AS first_page
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
pair_docs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.*,
    d1.journal AS journal_1, d1.year_val AS year_1, d1.first_page AS fp_1,
    d2.journal AS journal_2, d2.year_val AS year_2, d2.first_page AS fp_2
  FROM pair_activities pa
  LEFT JOIN docs_info d1 ON pa.doc_id_1 = d1.doc_id
  LEFT JOIN docs_info d2 ON pa.doc_id_2 = d2.doc_id
),
doc_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    did,
    dj,
    dy,
    dfp,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy) > 1 
      THEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy ORDER BY dfp) - 1) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dj, dy) - 1)
      ELSE 0 
    END AS percent_rank
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT doc_id_1 AS did, journal_1 AS dj, year_1 AS dy, fp_1 AS dfp
    FROM pair_docs
    UNION DISTINCT

  LEFT JOIN doc_ranked dr2 ON pd.doc_id_2 = dr2.did
),
pair_full_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    pw.*,
    COALESCE(CAST(year_1 AS STRING), '1970') AS pub_year_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 11) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_month_1,
    COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_1, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1') AS pub_day_1,

      LPAD(COALESCE(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(COALESCE(pr_2, 0) * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), '1'), 2, '0') AS date_str_2
  FROM pair_with_dates pw
),
final_pairs AS (

    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(activity_id_1, activity_id_2)))) AS activity_pair_uuid,
    TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(smiles_1, smiles_2)))) AS smiles_pair_uuid

  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
user_cohort AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2) DAY) AS cohort_monday
  FROM user_first_session
),
user_daily_activity AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS activity_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'

  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)
),
cohort_retention AS (
  SELECT 
    uc.cohort_monday,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
        WHEN uda.activity_date >= DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 21 DAY)
         AND uda.activity_date <= DATE_ADD(uc.cohort_monday, INTERVAL 27 DAY)
        THEN uc.user_pseudo_id

      COUNT(DISTINCT uc.user_pseudo_id)
    ) AS retention_rate_4th_week
  FROM user_cohort uc
  LEFT JOIN user_daily_activity uda 
    ON uc.user_pseudo_id = uda.user_pseudo_id
  GROUP BY uc.cohort_monday
)

-- Full query: For each quickplay event type, calculate retention rate
-- Retention = users with session_start in days 8-14 after first engagement / total users with that quickplay type

WITH 
-- Users whose first event was between Aug 1-15
cohort_users AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_engagement_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180815'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) >= '2018-08-01' 
     AND MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) <= '2018-08-15'
),

-- For each user in cohort, find their first quickplay event type
user_first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.first_engagement_date,
    e.event_name AS quickplay_event_type
  FROM cohort_users c
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON c.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
    AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180831'
  GROUP BY c.user_pseudo_id, c.first_engagement_date, e.event_name
),

-- Users who had session_start in second week (days 8-14) after their first engagement
retained_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    uq.user_pseudo_id,
    uq.quickplay_event_type
  FROM user_first_quickplay uq
  JOIN `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` e
    ON uq.user_pseudo_id = e.user_pseudo_id
    AND e.event_name = 'session_start'
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) >= DATE_ADD(uq.first_engagement_date, INTERVAL 8 DAY)
    AND PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', e.event_date) <= DATE_ADD(uq.first_engagement_date, INTERVAL 14 DAY)
)

SELECT 
  uq.quickplay_event_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id) AS total_users,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id) AS retained_users,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.user_pseudo_id), COUNT(DISTINCT uq.user_pseudo_id)) AS retention_rate
FROM user_first_quickplay uq
LEFT JOIN retained_users r
  ON uq.user_pseudo_id = r.user_pseudo_id
  AND uq.quickplay_event_type = r.quickplay_event_type
GROUP BY uq.quickplay_event_type
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
